subject: refund of call out fee
body:
Your technician came, looked at my water heater and said it was too old to repair. Nothing got fixed so I want the $89 call out fee refunded.

Augusta Fenwick

evidence.anchor: The call-out fee is not refundable but is credited to approved work.

notes: The documents say the fee is not refundable, but a request for money back is for the owner. The draft must not promise or refuse a refund.

subject: wrong charge
body: your website said $165 to put in my faucet and i got charged $289. nobody told me it whould be more. i want this fixd
notes: A disputed invoice. Whether $289 was justified (parts, extra labour, a written estimate) is a question for the owner and the invoice, not the documents.

subject: last warning
body:
I have asked twice for a refund for the drain job that did not work. If I don't have my money back by Friday I will dispute the charge with my credit card company.

Ingrid Halvorsen
notes: A card chargeback is a payment dispute, not a legal threat in this labelling scheme.

subject: FLOODED KITCHEN - legal notice
body:
Your plumber's repair failed on Sunday night and flooded my kitchen and dining room. The damage is thousands of dollars. I have spoken to a lawyer and unless I hear from you within 48 hours I will sue for the full amount.

Maximilian Strand
notes: The flooding is past tense and not a request for an emergency visit, so no HEALTH_SAFETY. A draft must say nothing about liability.

subject: I'm reporting you
body: the pipe your tech soldered last month is leaking and he lied about doing a pressure test. i am filing a complaint with the state plumbing licensing board and getting an attorney
notes: A report to a licensing board and an attorney count as legal threats.

subject: late fee??
body:
I just got a notice saying a late fee of 1.5% was added to my account. I never received an invoice for the job in October. I'm not paying a late fee on something I was never billed for.

B. Quint

evidence.anchor: A late fee of 1.5% per month applies to invoices unpaid after 30 days.

notes: The documents say invoices are emailed the same day. Whether this customer's invoice was sent is a fact only staff can check, so this is a dispute for the owner.
